description: SoundKit.SoundType -> what a sound kit is for. Surfaced as the type word on a sound pill, so a spell whose noise is an emote, a death or a tradeskill can be told from the 90% that are simply spell noises. The names are published in the WoWDBDefs DEFINITION's column comment rather than in a .dbde -- there is no SoundKit.dbde -- so they are copied here verbatim. Every build the roster packs carries the column, and -1 is the only value outside this list: 57 kits across five builds, reached by no spell, read as no type at all. Two values are both Footsteps, which is the source's own doing.
